description: This file implements the WebAudioPlayerClient class, which manages IPC communication for WebAudioPlayer state changes, including converting internal state enums to protocol buffer messages and sending events via an IPC client.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerClient
classes.description: Handles IPC communication for WebAudioPlayer state notifications.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Sends a WebAudioPlayerStateEvent with the current state via IPC.
